instruction: An action photograph with a high-angle full shot captures a bright white indoor studio where two cheerleaders perform a routine. In the foreground center, the cheerleader with long dark hair (R14) wears a white "Warsaw Mets" t-shirt, a white skirt with a red and yellow waistband, white knee-high socks, and white sneakers, standing in a wide stance with orange pom-poms. In the background right, the cheerleader with curly brown hair (R11) in a matching outfit is captured mid-motion, looking to her right. They perform a synchronized dance, holding metallic orange pom-poms. The scene is illuminated by bright, even studio lighting with vertical light tubes in the background, casting soft shadows on the white floor.
